content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): First Class Post Graduate Degree (including the integrated PG degrees) in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering and related areas with 2 years of research experience after M.Tech. Minimum 2 years of research/development experience after M.Tech in instrumentation, device design, embedded systems, medical-device development, mechatronics, optics, electronics, or related areas.

content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Maximum Age: 30 years as on the last day of application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT Hyderabad) for filling temporary research positions under an ICMR-funded project based in Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad has advertised for the post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) in mechanical, electrical engineering, and related technical research areas.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering and related areas with at least 2 years of research experience after M.Tech.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years as calculated on the last day of application submission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56000 per month plus 30% HRA as per the guidelines of the funding agency.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form through the provided Google Form link is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted purely in online mode by filling out the designated Google Form link provided in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their academic records and relevant work experience or publications, followed by an online interview for shortlisted individuals.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the direct link to apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct application Google Form link in the Important Links section of this article as well as in the official notification details.
